scope.method: Normal Android TV Settings picker selected through ADB UI input. Temporary receiver sends Lua messages over the existing Divoom control service; real Ditoo HID reports are observed with getevent and media_session. Android input injection is used only for setup/navigation, never the tested remote action.

fresh_pairing.picker_path: Remotes and accessories > Pair accessory > Ditoo BLE Remote

warm_reconnect.trigger: Saved app disconnect, wait approximately four seconds, then connect

restart_test.method: Reflash identical 306035 image over BLE, causing firmware restart. Maintenance app lived only in RAM; saved remote and settings were not overwritten.
restart_test.post_update_version_verification: Initial upgrade CLI read 306035. Same-version restart flash received device success but CLI could not reconnect to old public control address after app switched identities; TV control receiver independently read and required 306035 before sending any Lua message.

other_input_checks.note: Earlier build in this investigation; final 306035 Play/Pause repeated above. Space and arrows depend on player focus. TV vendor volume-down behavior could also mute despite one ordinary DOWN/UP pair; no Android settings or code changed.

offline_checks.native: 32-bit ASan/UBSan tests passed, including cached-flash simulation, journal read-back failure, scoped bond restoration, report-map delay/backpressure/cancellation, separate launch and callback budgets, and hostile Lua recovery.
offline_checks.reproducibility: Two isolated builds of all four maintained profiles matched images, JSON build reports and patch reports.
baseline_limitations: Repository-wide cargo fmt check has pre-existing formatting differences.
Strict all-target Clippy has pre-existing test unwrap warnings; production lib/bins strict check passed.

limitations: Physical buttons and a mains power cycle were not actuated in this run.
Raw logs and endpoint captures remain private in ignored target/tv-pairing-fix/.
BLE updater post-restart verification still targets its original address. A saved app that switches to the remote identity can require version verification through the active remote address or USB.
